rv.q: Saunders earns every ‘absolutely fabulous’ accolade the part won her.
So, unlike Elvira’s return to the mortal plane, this play’s revival is, on balance, a good thing for everyone involved.
But that’s precisely what it is.

cn.t: Jennifer Saunders charms as Madame Arcati in Richard Eyre's revival of Coward's comedy, but critics are divided—some find it agreeable fun, while others feel the production strains too hard for laughs and lacks sparkle.
